```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)

```


```{r}
#Histogram of renewable energy
load("project_data.RData")

ggplot(project_data, aes(renewable_energy)) +
  geom_histogram(fill="steelblue", bins=30) +
  labs(title="Distribution of Renewable Energy")

```


```{r}
#Renewable energy by continent

ggplot(project_data, aes(continent, renewable_energy, fill=continent)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

#CO2 by Continent
ggplot(project_data, aes(continent, co2, fill=continent)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal()

```



```{r}
#Average renewable energy over years
project_data %>%
group_by(year) %>%
summarise(avg = mean(renewable_energy, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
ggplot(aes(year, avg)) +
geom_line(linewidth=1.2, color="blue") +
labs(title="Global Renewable Energy Trend")

```

```{r}
#Global Average CO2 Over Time
project_data %>%
group_by(year) %>%
summarise(avg = mean(co2, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
ggplot(aes(year, avg)) +
geom_line(color="red", linewidth=1.2)
```


```{r}
#Electricity Access Over Time
project_data %>%
group_by(year) %>%
summarise(avg = mean(electricity_access, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
ggplot(aes(year, avg)) +
geom_line(color="darkgreen", linewidth=1.2)

```


```{r}
#GDP vs Renewable Energy
ggplot(project_data,
       aes(gdp_per_capita, renewable_energy)) +
geom_point(alpha=.5) +
geom_smooth(method="lm")

```


```{r}
#GDP vs CO2
ggplot(project_data,
       aes(gdp_per_capita, co2)) +
geom_point(alpha=.5)

```


```{r}
#CO2 vs Renewable Energy
ggplot(project_data,
       aes(co2, renewable_energy)) +
geom_point(alpha=.5)

```



```{r}
#Top 10 GDP Countries
project_data %>%
filter(year == max(year, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
arrange(desc(gdp_per_capita)) %>%
slice_head(n=10) %>%
ggplot(aes(reorder(country, gdp_per_capita),
           gdp_per_capita)) +
geom_col(fill="purple") +
coord_flip()

```


```{r}
#Choropleth World Map
#install.packages(c("rnaturalearth","rnaturalearthdata"))
library(rnaturalearth)
library(sf)

world <- ne_countries(scale="medium", returnclass="sf")

map_df <- world %>%
left_join(project_data %>%
filter(year==max(year)) ,
by=c("name"="country"))

ggplot(map_df)+
geom_sf(aes(fill=renewable_energy), color="white", size=.1)+
scale_fill_viridis_c()+
labs(title="Global Renewable Energy Use")

```

```{r}
#Heatmap 
#Renewable energy by continent across years.

heat_data <- project_data %>%
group_by(continent, year) %>%
summarise(avg = mean(renewable_energy, na.rm=TRUE))

ggplot(heat_data,
aes(year, continent, fill=avg))+
geom_tile()+
scale_fill_viridis_c()+
labs(title="Renewable Energy Heatmap")

```

```{r}
#Faceted Trend Chart
#Instead of messy many-country line chart.

top <- c("United States","China","India","Germany")

project_data %>%
filter(country %in% top) %>%
ggplot(aes(year, renewable_energy))+
geom_line(color="darkgreen")+
facet_wrap(~country)+
labs(title="Renewable Energy Trends")

```


```{r}
#Bubble Scatterplot (Keep This)
scatter_data <- project_data %>%
  filter(year == max(year, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(gdp_per_capita),
    !is.na(renewable_energy),
    !is.na(co2),
    !is.na(continent)
  )

ggplot(scatter_data,
aes(gdp_per_capita,
renewable_energy,
size=co2,
color=continent))+
geom_point(alpha=.7)+
scale_x_log10()+
theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
#Slopegraph


library(tidyr)

slope <- project_data %>%
filter(year %in% c(2000,max(year))) %>%
filter(country %in% c("China","India","Germany","United States"))

ggplot(slope,
aes(x=year,y=renewable_energy,group=country,color=country))+
geom_line(size=1.2)+
geom_point(size=3)

```















This plot shows how renewable energy consumption has changed over time for selected countries. We observe that some countries, such as Germany, show a steady increase in renewable energy use, while others have slower growth. This highlights differences in energy policies and levels of investment in sustainable energy across countries.
